provenance.approvedScope: root-approved headless report-only four-arm screen; no production/canonical/reference write
provenance.source: accepted Plan 13 race-physics.mjs; in-memory affine adapter and arm-specific transforms only
provenance.model: topSpeed = 8.25 + 0.5 * sampledPerformance; accepted base/rest/trial/stance order is unchanged
provenance.cells: 3 roster tiers × 2 field/race inputs × 2 stances × 2 trial states × 3 rest factors = 72

studyOnlyConstants.assistance: every40 ticks; 0.5 keyed success; rank4-6; gap>=2m; acceleration5 vs3 for max40 ticks; recovery/recentering lookahead6m vs10m; turn cap min(90,1.5x current); correction max20deg; cooldown80; max2 windows/entrant; topSpeed, braking and nominal corner target unchanged
studyOnlyConstants.leaderSlowdown: when a rank1-2 weave enters hold, targetSpeed x0.8 for at most20 ticks; unchanged12-16deg target/10tick hold, normal braking/acceleration; nonstacking, max2/entrant

provenance.order: Per tick, freeze rank/gap at tick start; process existing weave keys/opportunity; process assistance from the frozen snapshot; then advance speed/turn and recovery. Slowdown triggers from tick-start rank when a weave enters hold. Penalty/assistance episode endpoints are frozen at their actual ends.

assistance.attribution: Paired arm deltas support causal comparison; individual within-race observed gap changes are descriptive, not attributed to a mechanic.
